exposure: yoga and meditation practice during pregnancy and labor
outcome: Wijma Delivery Expectancy/Experience Questionnaire A and B scores
Childbirth Self-Efficacy Scale (CBSEI) Short Form scores
cohort: The study included 90 primiparous pregnant women who applied to a hospital's pregnancy school and met the study's acceptance criteria.
finding: The intervention group, practicing yoga and meditation, achieved higher vaginal delivery rates, lower labor intervention and episiotomy frequencies, reduced pain and fear perception, and increased self-efficacy during labor, despite an increase in their STAI scores post-intervention.
mod_finding: The intervention group demonstrated statistically higher vaginal delivery rates and lower labor intervention rates compared to the control group.
